question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: 10-trading-day forward windows with spot VIX 16-19 at the start; the max INTRADAY print in such windows runs a median ~1.15-1.20x spot, floored near spot (max >= first-day level) and with a long right tail. FRED VIXCLS: 09-11 close 15.84, 09-10 close 17.84, Aug range 14.25-16.50; VIX is back near 18 on 09-14 (Yahoo ^VIX), so the regime is already off the August lull. Starting level for Sep 21 is itself uncertain: a delivered-as-priced hike on Sep 16 usually produces an event-vol crush (spot 15-17), while a hawkish surprise or further oil/rates escalation leaves it 19-24. Blending gives a median start near 16.5-17 and a median window max near 20. Right-tail support: Brent ~$105 with Hormuz flows disrupted, 10y near 5%, first Fed hike since 2023 into a tape where Nasdaq momentum is rolling over, plus the seasonally worst two-week stretch of the year (post-Sep-opex through early Oct) and an Oct 2 payrolls print inside the window. Left-tail support: the Oct 1 shutdown catalyst was removed by the Sep 2 CR (funds to Dec 11), Aug CPI came in in line, and equities rallied on 09-11 as crude retreated. Evidence is decent on levels/calendar but thin on positioning; I stay close to the reference-class ratio rather than pressing the tail. 2% priced above 50 for a Hormuz-closure/disorderly-bond or AI-unwind escalation; no mechanism gets the 10-day max below 10, so no lower escape.

disagreements.verdict: Settled at ~85-88% - Run 2's prediction-market figures are dated Sep 2; Runs 1/3 cite post-CPI Sep 12-14 FedWatch. A near-fully-priced, pre-window decision favors an event-vol crush.

disagreements.claim: October VIX futures are in the low 20s (Run 1) vs 18.4-19.1 (Run 3)
disagreements.verdict: Settled at 18.4-19.1 - Run 1's quote is from Dec 2025/Jul 2026 and stale; Run 3 retrieved the live front month on Sep 13. Ordinary contango, which argues against a median above ~21.

disagreements.claim: The Gulf war / 10y-near-5% / 91st-percentile-skew backdrop should raise the median, not just the tail
disagreements.verdict: Not breakable on available evidence. I take the tail reading: equities absorbed ~six sessions of oil shock with VIX under 19, and the futures curve is not pricing stress. Right tail kept fat (p90 28.0, 1.5% above 50), center left at the base rate.

disagreements.claim: The Oct 1 appropriations cliff sits inside the window
disagreements.verdict: Resolved no - all three runs independently confirm a CR signed 2026-09-02 funding through 2026-12-11. The in-window fiscal catalyst is removed; next cliff is after the window.

calls.reference_class: Non-overlapping 10-trading-day forward windows entered with spot VIX in the 15-18.5 band; statistic = maximum intraday (daily-high) VIX inside the window
